title: Both wallets join
text: Wallet A and Wallet B join circle #6 on Monad testnet. Each locks a 2 cUSD deposit and enables auto-pay. The circle has two rounds, with a 1 cUSD contribution per member in each round.

title: CRE draws the payout order
text: The CRE workflow reads the Chainlink BTC/USD feed and records the payout order: Wallet A first, Wallet B second. The Cowrie app and the terminal show the same result.

title: Round one contributions
text: CRE pulls 1 cUSD from each opted-in member. Cowrie confirms the contribution, and the terminal records the transaction hash.

title: Round one payout
text: After the round timer ends, CRE settles the round. Wallet A receives the 2 cUSD pot, and the circle advances to round two.

title: Round two contributions and payout
text: CRE collects the next 1 cUSD contribution from both members. When the second timer ends, Wallet B receives 2 cUSD. Cowrie marks the circle complete.

title: Every round. Paid out.
text: Two rounds paid out, four contributions collected, and five verified CRE transactions. Recorded with test cUSD on Monad testnet using CRE simulation with broadcast.
